channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump doubles down on threat to halt trade with top partners unless Fed cuts rates
item.description: President Donald Trump demanded that the Fed slash interest rates or else he will cut off trade with countries with which the U.S. maintains trade deficits.

item.title: Tesla's stock drops 6% as Cybercab update 'underwhelms' Wall Street
item.description: Tesla's long-awaited Cybercab update failed to dazzle investors.

item.title: From Trump’s takeover threats to a ‘northern neighborhood,’ why the EU chief is going to Greenland
item.description: The visit comes as Trump renews his push for greater U.S. control of the self-governing Danish territory.

item.title: Longtime Fox News host Maria Bartiromo disputes reports of termination
item.description: Maria Bartiromo, the longtime host of Fox News and Fox Business programming, has disputed reports she was fired from the cable TV networks.

item.title: Dow tumbles more than 260 points after strong jobs report reignites rate hike fears: Live updates
item.description: August's hotter-than-expected payrolls reading increased expectations that the Federal Reserve could raise interest rates at its next meeting.

item.title: Investors zero in on August inflation data in the week ahead after yields spike to levels not seen in years
item.description: Next week's inflation data takes on even greater importance for investors as they try to determine where the Federal Reserve could go with interest rates.

item.title: World's biggest sovereign wealth fund plans to cut U.S. Treasury holdings
item.description: Norway's $2.3 trillion investment fund says it can diversify into new areas with greater risk and returns.

item.title: Trump says he will spend up to $500 million of 'my money' to help Republicans in midterms
item.description: Trump's pledge would dramatically increase MAGA Inc.’s spending after the Trump-aligned PAC kept most of its $403 million war chest on the sidelines.

item.title: Judge weighs how to dismiss Reflecting Pool vandalism charge against Olympian
item.description: President Trump has said damage to the Reflecting Pool was due to vandalism, not to a flawed installation of a new liner as prosecutors say.

item.title: Women accounted for almost all of job gains in August. Here's why
item.description: Women accounted for virtually all of August's payroll gains, the latest sign of their growing power in the labor market.

item.title: THC drinks could soon be harder to find as Congress delays hemp ban again
item.description: THC drinks are booming as an alcohol alternative, but a looming federal crackdown is squeezing makers, distributors and consumers.

item.title: The big business of personal protection: How private security became a $50 billion industry
item.description: Private security spending and guard employment have climbed as companies and communities respond to high-profile attacks, even as violent crime falls.

item.title: U.S. sanctions Turkish bank accused of enabling Iran as Bessent says he 'hopes for' no further bank penalties
item.description: President Donald Trump hyped the sanctions plan as "economic D-Day" against Iran, but the U.S. has so far taken few steps to implement it.

item.title: These companies are growing their dividends and may see upside, Morgan Stanley says
item.description: September is typically a rough patch for stocks, but adding a few dividend payers may help smooth the ride for investors.

item.title: Diesel hits record high as Ukraine and Iran wars knock out refineries, fueling inflation worries
item.description: Higher prices come as Ukraine pounds Russian refineries, forcing Moscow to ban diesel exports.

item.title: WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert to retire at the end of 2026
item.description: Engelbert oversaw a period of unprecedented growth for the WNBA, but has faced criticism from players over her leadership.

item.title: Mike Khouw: Cybercabs are a game changer—here's how I'm trading Tesla
item.description: The strategist at YieldMaxETFs breaks down how a bullish bet on Tesla could pay off for options traders.

item.title: Analysis: Lower Treasury yields could require a weaker economy. Trump won't fix them
item.description: Long-term Treasury yields are being held up by Trump-era policy risk, heavy government borrowing and AI-driven corporate debt.

item.title: Labor Day marks the start of 'fallcations' as wealthy travelers avoid summer crowds
item.description: Wealthy travelers are moving their typical summer getaways to autumn.

item.title: U.S. 'Economic Outcast’ operation gains momentum as EU joins sanctions; South Korea weighs military backing
item.description: The EU formally joined the U.S.-led sanctions campaign against Iran, while South Korea said it's weighing a military role to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: What strong jobs data means for rates — plus, an out-of-favor trade shines this week
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: American Express Experiences guide: Exclusive ticket presales and special access to live events
item.description: If you're an Amex cardholder, you can use the American Express Experiences portal for access to exclusive events.

item.title: Lululemon stock plunges 20% on disappointing earnings and outlook
item.description: Lululemon posted another quarter of disappointing results and a sales slowdown as the company struggles to turn its business around.

item.title: Global bond sell-off likely not over yet, Mohamed El-Erian tells CNBC
item.description: In a wide-ranging interview, the renowned economist also said the U.S. Treasury had taken "a step too far" with its market intervention.

item.title: Why Nvidia's 'defensive move' to acquire Hugging Face is about much more than chips
item.description: Nvidia’s $12.9 billion Hugging Face deal could protect its open AI ecosystem, deepen ties with developers and keep the platform from rivals.

item.title: Argentina's Milei escalates Falklands dispute as Trump questions U.S. support for Britain
item.description: Argentina's President Javier Milei has renewed the country's claim to the Falkland Islands and threatened sanctions on oil companies.

item.title: 2-year yield rises to highest since January 2025 after hot jobs report boosts expectations that the Fed could raise rates
item.description: Treasury yields rose as the hot jobs report along with sticky inflation may give the Fed more cover to hike interest rates in September.

item.title: OpenAI agents hijacked German website in previously undisclosed AI breakout this spring: Reuters
item.description: Rogue OpenAI agents hijacked a German website this spring and transformed it into a bulletin ⁠board for other AI agents, Reuters reports.

item.title: The wealth of the world's billionaires reached $15.1 trillion last year, per a new report
item.description: The global billionaire count hit a record of 3,795 people last year, with the biggest wealth gains for the richest of the rich, per a recent Altrata report.

item.title: A living room unlike any other—how to gather and connect like Gloria Steinem, says expert
item.description: Steinem's living room "cracked open opportunities to lend support, let ideas flow, and build trust face-to-face," says journalist and author Allison Gilbert, founder of More Connected.
